get_content_comments.description:
Get top-level comments for a video, article, or dynamic.

Each comment includes up to 3 preview sub-replies, image metadata, and note
metadata. Use the comment's `rpid` as `root_rpid` with
`get_content_comment_replies` to retrieve the complete reply thread. Pagination
is cursor-based; keep `sort` unchanged while paging. The pinned `top` comment is
only present on the first page. For a note, pass `note.cvid` to
`get_article_content` to retrieve its full content; the comment API may return
only a preview.

content_id.description: Video BVID/AV/URL, article CV id or opus id, or dynamic/opus id. Keep 64-bit IDs as strings.

content_type.description: Content type: video, article, or dynamic. Dynamic IDs are resolved to Bilibili's actual comment type and oid.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page and keep sort unchanged while paging.

get_user_snapshot.description:
Get a one-call user overview: profile plus recent videos, dynamics and articles.

Sections are fetched concurrently, so prefer this over separate
get_user_info/get_user_videos/get_user_dynamics/get_user_articles calls
when you need a broad view of a user. A failed section is reported under
`errors` while the remaining sections are still returned. Set a
section's limit to 0 to skip it.

article_limit.description: Recent articles to include, 0-30. 0 skips the section.

dynamic_limit.description: Recent dynamics to include, 0-30. 0 skips the section.

video_limit.description: Recent videos to include, 0-30. 0 skips the section.

get_video_detail.description:
Get video detail including owner.mid (uploader UID) and total duration in seconds.

Subtitle text is returned only in subtitles.full_text; tracks contain
metadata and their text field is always empty. selected_language applies
only to smart mode; full mode returns null and identifies languages in
tracks[].lan. Check errors and truncated for incomplete text. Subtitles
have no timecodes. Empty video.tags can mean the source omitted tags.
Both smart and full default to P1 unless a page/CID or URL p is supplied.
Set subtitle_scope=all with a BVID or URL without p for all pages.
Read subtitles.scope for the selected range and actual returned pages;
returned_pages can contain partial text, so still check errors/truncated.
Page selection only applies when fetch_subtitles=true.

bvid.description: Video BVID (e.g. BV1xx411c7mD), AV number (e.g. av170001), full Bilibili video URL, or b23.tv short link.

fetch_subtitles.description: Whether to fetch and aggregate subtitle tracks.

subtitle_cid.description: Subtitle CID belonging to this video. Mutually exclusive with subtitle_page; must agree with URL p if present.

subtitle_lang.description: Requested subtitle language code in smart mode (e.g. zh-CN, en-US). Use auto for built-in priority fallback.

subtitle_max_chars.description: Maximum subtitle text characters returned in this response.

subtitle_mode.description: Subtitle fetch mode when fetch_subtitles=true: minimal (no subtitle API), smart (single best track text), full (all track texts within the selected page scope).

subtitle_page.description: Subtitle part number starting at 1. Mutually exclusive with subtitle_cid; must agree with URL p if present.

subtitle_scope.description: Subtitle page range, independent of language/track mode: single (default; URL p, explicit page/CID, or P1), all (scan every page; cannot combine with page/CID or URL p).

get_video_detail.name: get_video_detail

full_text.description: Subtitle text, returned once within subtitle_max_chars; multiple full-mode tracks have language/part labels. No timecodes.
full_text.title: Full Text

returned_pages.description: Pages with at least one subtitle text character returned. This does not guarantee complete text; inspect errors and truncated.
returned_pages.title: Returned Pages

target_page.description: Selected page number in single scope; null in all scope.
target_page.title: Target Page

selected_language.description: Selected track language in smart mode. Null in full/minimal/disabled modes; use tracks[].lan for full mode.
selected_language.title: Selected Language

tracks.description: Track metadata only. A track can be listed even if its text failed to download; inspect errors.

text.description: Compatibility field, always empty. Read subtitles.full_text for text.
text.title: Text

tracks.title: Tracks

ctime.description: Upstream creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.
ctime.title: Ctime

duration.description: Total video duration in seconds, across all parts.
duration.title: Duration

tags.description: Tags supplied by the detail source. Empty can mean unavailable, not no tags.
tags.title: Tags
